card.text: Sun-like K dwarf 3.6 parsecs away, with a cold giant planet and a pair of brown dwarfs.

sources.label: Lundkvist et al. 2024
sources.quote: The star is noteworthy for harboring a pair of brown dwarf companions and a Jupiter-type planet

introduction.text: Epsilon Indi A is one of the nearest Sun-like stars, 3.6 parsecs away. JWST has imaged its planet Ab, and a pair of brown dwarfs circles it 1,460 au out.

sources.label: Sanghi et al. 2026
sources.quote: the nearby (3.6 pc) cold (275 K) gas giant exoplanet

sources.label: Scholz et al. 2003
sources.quote: as a common proper motion companion (separation 1459AU) to the K5V star Epsilon Indi
